## What a teacher will notice · 선생님이 알아챌 변화

## What changed · 바뀐 것

## Checks · 확인

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run e2e` pass locally
- [ ] No child names, photos or per-child data are stored or logged
- [ ] Observational language only in anything a child sees or hears
- [ ] UI strings go through `t()` and exist in every `js/locales/*.js`
- [ ] If a pack changed: `packs/index.json` updated, `validatePack` passes
